profile: Gemma native turn stopping with bounded free allocator cache
kv_quantization: default model precision; not additionally quantized
empty_content_policy: JSON null or empty model content becomes an empty hypothesis, retaining the raw response and going through the same judge
oracle_question_date_policy: Each official variant uses its own question date and history timestamps; text/answers/types match across selected IDs.
source_note: Per-item code hashes and archived source are authoritative. Operational recovery bypasses disabled SDK telemetry only; shipping supervisor adds independent directory checks and IPv6 redaction after the final process launched. Shipping supervisor also persists the fixed absolute deadline automatically for resumptions.
